scope: Exact reviewed no-layer-split serving/BGEN/mixed-prefill paths; static callgraph, not runtime observation or universal callback proof.
conclusion: EP2 can enable scalar async. BGEN maps GEN1; request entry and scalar request completion drain wait_commit before slot activation. read_windows drains after its scalar commits; read_part only Prefill::run, so its inter-chunk batch calls do not introduce scalar pending. Every prior successful S79 batch joins before return. Stale-pending refusal and warm fail-stop remain defense, not bypassed.
